description: Get The Standard Reserve (TSR)'s reserve backing on Robinhood Chain: vault ETH balances, reserve-asset holdings, the Uniswap v4 positions the expansion vault owns (vault_positions), and eth_backing_per_standard (ETH per circulating STANDARD) in three variants. excluding_pol is vault ETH only, the conservative figure. including_pol adds total POL-controlled ETH (idle + position principal + uncollected fees) and is null when pol_position_basis is position_inventory_unavailable. including_reserve_assets adds the ETH value of vault_positions and of the priced reserve_assets to vault ETH, leaves out POL, and is null until a snapshot has both positions and prices. Part of the vault's ETH was redeployed into USDG and Uniswap v4 pools, so excluding_pol and including_pol fall when that happens. reserve_value splits the reserve-inclusive figure into components (vault_positions_eth, usdg_eth, stock_tokens_eth), a total, and an unpriced list. Stock tokens and positions are valued at the current price in the Reserve's own stock/USDG pools and USDG at $1 via Chainlink ETH/USD, so selling a large amount would fetch less; eth_value and valuation on reserve_assets name the basis, and unpriced assets keep eth_value null. Position STANDARD and per-range POL liquidity are also returned. No variant includes ETH held by the tax hook or fee splitter (see hook_eth_balance_raw/fee_splitter_eth_balance_raw on 1s_std_buyback_readiness); that ETH is tax collected on trades awaiting a forwardTaxes() call, not vault-held backing. Pass history_hours to get the backing-ratio history instead of the current snapshot, or atBlock to get the backing snapshot at or before that block (ignored when history_hours is set). Fields ending in _raw are 18-decimal integers as strings; divide by 1e18 to get token amounts.

atBlock.description: Return the backing snapshot at or before this block instead of the latest one

history_hours.description: When set, return backing-ratio history for this many hours instead of the current snapshot

name: 1s_std_backing
